necessary_context.content: Euclidean norm throughout. f is rho-weakly convex when f(x)+(rho/2)||x||^2 is convex. The subdifferential convention is the first-order lower-support definition on p.10. Eq.(2.5) gives f(y)>=f(x)+<v,y-x>-(rho/2)||y-x||^2 for v in partial f(x).
necessary_context.locator: p.8 opening definition; pp.10–11 §2.2, Lemma 2.1 and Eq.(2.5)
necessary_context.name: Weak convexity and subgradient inequality

necessary_context.content: phi=f+iota_X. phi_lambda(x)=min_y{phi(y)+||y-x||^2/(2lambda)}. prox_{lambda phi}(x) is the minimizer. For lambda<1/rho, Lemma 2.2 gives gradient phi_lambda(x)=(x-prox_{lambda phi}(x))/lambda. Small envelope gradient concerns a nearby proximal point and does not directly assert small raw subgradient at x.
necessary_context.locator: p.11 Eq.(2.6), Lemma 2.2 and following near-stationarity discussion
necessary_context.name: Moreau envelope

necessary_context.content: On a probability space (Omega,F,P), fresh iid samples are available. For open U containing dom r, measurable G:U x Omega -> R^d satisfies E G(x,xi) in partial f(x) for every x in U. For finite L>=0, E||G(x,xi)||^2<=L^2 for every x in dom r. In §3.1, r=iota_X for a closed convex X.
necessary_context.name: Assumption A
